filename_note: The original filename asserted a proposition beyond what the evidence carries. The canonical title is neutral-descriptive; the original is preserved here as a record. This substitution is made in the paper itself (§VIII, frontmatter) and is not an archive-side edit.

hosting.status: PAPER SEATED AT PROVENANCEERASURE.ORG; EVIDENCE NOT YET SEATED
hosting.why: The paper is seated at provenanceerasure.org beside its predecessor at /suppression-inversion/. Alexanarch mints and describes it but does not host it. The evidentiary appendix and the four transcript-image files are large and are currently held by the custodian in a private repository; the destination directory exists at /rebuttal-as-warrant/evidence/ with a README naming them by designator and hash, so the slot is legible rather than an empty folder or a link resolving to nothing.
hosting.access: By request to the custodian. The archive holds no copy and cannot grant access.

files.note: Preserves device time, google.com domain display, UI elements and hyperlink positions. A page-position table in §I reconciles all 31 pages against the device clock.

Four files of transcript images deposited to data-rhizome by the custodian on 2026-08-30. Filenames and hashes NOT recorded here: the archive has not seen these files and does not assert properties of objects it has not inspected. To be filled by the custodian, or on a future pass with access.

determinability: Every claim in the paper is determinable from the display layer preserved in the evidentiary appendix. The paper states this as a design requirement (§4.2, evidence scope) and declines to assert anything about the full body text of the four cited documents (§4.3.2, §10.1 1c).

verified_by_archive.what: The three cited Zenodo/GitHub items are independently checkable against the archive's own record of the same termination event.
verified_by_archive.detail: Issues #2606 and #2596 on zenodo/zenodo are the threads in which the Crimson Hexagonal Archive's own termination case is filed; the archive can confirm those threads exist and carry contestation filings. It does NOT thereby confirm anything about what Google's AI Mode displayed on 2026-08-26 — that rests on the appendix alone.
verified_by_archive.limit: The archive verifies the existence of two of the four cited items and nothing about the capture.

note_on_discipline: Strutturista della psiche is Enli Lucente's DISCIPLINE — structural psychology, in Italian — and not a heteronym. It has been mistranslated as one. Recorded here so the error does not propagate through the archive's own metadata.
